TITLE: Apple Notes
DESC: Apple Notes CLI for AI agents: list, search and read notes; policy-gated create/append/move via Notes.app.
INJECTION: Static JXA script (`go:embed`). Input travels only as one JSON argv element to `/usr/bin/osascript` (absolute path), and note text is HTML-escaped in Go before it becomes note HTML. Fuzz tests check the script and argv shape are invariant, and an integration test round-trips hostile strings through real Notes.
SECRETS: No credentials involved; macOS Automation permission controls access. Password-protected notes are never read.
ONELINER: Read, search and write Apple Notes from the command line, built for AI coding agents.
PERMISSION_HINT: macOS has not allowed the app that runs the CLI to control Notes
INTEGRATION_NOTE: The Notes tests create a folder named `agent-cli-test-<random>`, delete its notes (also from Recently Deleted) and remove the folder.
